author: Emma Roth
content:

OpenAI's ChatGPT, xAI's Grok, and Anthropic's Claude are all experiencing issues. At around 11AM ET, ChatGPT started returning error messages for users trying to use the chatbot, with its [status page saying](https://status.openai.com/) there are currently "elevated errors across ChatGPT and Codex."

title: (No AI) Google says its AI weather model is getting better
author: Justine Calma
content:
![Image of the Google “G” logo on a blue, black, and purple background.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/24016886/STK093_Google_03.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Google is rolling out an updated AI weather model that's supposed to be more accurate, especially when it comes to predicting rain and snowfall.

In the announcement today, the company says it's now able to make forecasts with "unprecedented resolution" using its new WeatherNext 3 AI model. It can produce a global picture that's five times sharper than Google's [previous model](https://www.theverge.com/news/822489/weather-forecast-ai-model-google-weathernext) by learning from real-time weather observations, according to the company.
